description: Today's (or any date's) US Treasury par yield curve: 1-month to 30-year yields including the 10-year and 2-year, the change from the previous business day and from a month earlier, and the 10y-2y and 10y-3m spreads with an inversion flag. Any date back to 1990.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, back to 1990-01-02. Default the latest published day.

name: treasury_yield_curve
title: Treasury yield curve
